title: Existence of the concrete Godement augmentation
statement: For a Godement cosimplicial object with prescribed cofaces, the degree-zero germ extends to an augmentation satisfying ModuleCupGodementModel.

proof.text: Project to each stalk skyscraper and evaluate a germ to prove naturality of the concrete unit. Transport the prescribed degree-zero cofaces along the term equalities. Naturality identifies their composites with the germ, so the alternating differential annihilates it. Transport the germ through extendXIso and use HomologicalComplex.mkHomFromSingle; its degree-zero component and cancellation of the transport isomorphisms give ModuleCupGodementModel.

proof_origin.by: F1 stage-3 worker; independently checked and augmentation proved by F1 second reader

from.place: Existence of a single augmented concrete Godement model

mathlib_searches.query: Extend a morphism from an object to degree zero of a cochain complex when its differential vanishes
mathlib_searches.results: CochainComplex.fromSingle₀Equiv found; used integer-indexed HomologicalComplex.mkHomFromSingle instead

lean.statement:
theorem moduleCup_godement_augmentation_exists (X : Scheme.{u}) (F : X.Modules)
    (A : CosimplicialObject X.Modules)
    (h : ∀ n : ℕ, A.obj ⦋n⦌ = moduleCup_godementIterate X F (n + 1))
    (hδ : ∀ (n : ℕ) (i : Fin (n + 2)),
      eqToHom (h n) ≫ moduleCup_godementInsert X F (n + 1) i =
        A.map (SimplexCategory.δ i) ≫ eqToHom (h (n + 1))) :
    ∃ a : (CochainComplex.singleFunctor X.Modules 0).obj F ⟶
        (((alternatingCofaceMapComplex X.Modules).obj A).extend
          ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat),
      ModuleCupGodementModel X F A a
